create_UnprojReprojLayer: create a UnprojReprojLayer module for unprojecting and reprojecting latent features with configurable 3D grid and volume rendering
build_ConvBlock: build a ConvBlock neural network layer with configurable convolution, normalization, and ReLU activation
run_UnprojReprojLayer_forward: run the UnprojReprojLayer forward pass to project 2D latent features into 3D voxel grids and volume-render back to 2D images
get_volume_renderer_params: get the volume renderer parameters separately from other model parameters for differentiated optimizer grouping
configure_aggregator_mode: configure the aggregator mode to mean-aggregate or use IBRNet to reduce multiple per-frame voxel grids into a single 3D grid
